Goods must be returned in their original packaging and as new, the cost and risks of returning the goods being borne by the Purchaser. Once the returned goods have been received and inspected, shop shall send the Purchaser a credit note corresponding to the amount of the original invoice, after deduction of any compensation or expenses which arise from any reconditioning work deemed necessary.
